item.title: Burnline 0.1.0-nightly.20261113
item.description:
Changes

  • Cover a part-quarter day every run, so coverage stops changing between runs
  • Publish each stable release to a Homebrew tap
  • Strip release builds, and check the app inside the disk image
  • Build, sign and publish releases and nightlies from a workflow
  • Sign releases with one certificate and pack them in a designed disk image
  • Stop a hung test run in minutes, and never block on a child's exit
  • Keep the release cache at the path it is restored to
  • Run the child-process tests one at a time
  • Say what a helper test saw when its ready line does not come
  • Warm CI's caches from the branches pull requests target
  • Read a helper's readiness and id from one line
  • Measure only what can change speed, and build the base once
  • Give real child processes time to answer on a starved runner
  • Explain a failed child-process send, and fit the insert floor to CI
  • Stop a live-usage test failing on a busy runner
  • Build the performance suites in release, and report a failed build
  • Update in app, from a stable or a nightly channel
  • Show the app in the README, from a demo store of invented usage
  • Fail a pull request that is slower than its base or over a budget
  • Describe decisions and tests in their own words
  • Start Burnline's public history
